purpose: Rust 2024 native compilation, Clippy, formatting and wasm32-unknown-unknown builds.
limitations: WASM target compilation is tested; a WASM runtime and browser execution are not provided.
No CUE executable or global third-party Cargo tools are included.

changes: Accept a mounted multi-certificate PEM CA bundle; validate all certificates before replacing managed trust and retain single-certificate and root/user behavior.
1.99-trixie.migration: Compatible CA setup fix. Continue using the normal root entrypoint and mount a certificate or PEM bundle read-only through LIBRARY_CA_FILE (CA_CERTIFICATE in wrappers). Existing explicit Composer/Node CA settings and PUID/PGID behavior remain supported. Published pins stay unchanged until deliberately upgraded to a verified release.
